```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(scCustomize)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
data <- Read10X(data_dir, gene.column = 1)
```

```{r}
seu <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = data)
```

```{r}
as.anndata(
  x = seu,
  file_path = "H:\\CS 223 Feedback\\Project\\data",
  file_name = "output_file.h5ad",
  assay = "RNA",
  main_layer = "counts",  # Directs the function to your only available layer
  other_layers = NULL     # Prevents it from looking for secondary layers
)

```
